name: Harborlight quickstart

onCreateCommand.sandbox-deps: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y bubblewrap sqlite3 python3
onCreateCommand.install-opaque: curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opaque-dev/opaque/main/install.sh -o /tmp/opaque-install.sh && sudo env OPAQUE_INSTALL=/usr/local/bin sh /tmp/opaque-install.sh && rm /tmp/opaque-install.sh && opaque --version

postAttachCommand:
printf '
Harborlight quickstart — run: ./quickstart.sh --ci

A codespace has no biometric approver, so CI mode is the path here. Approvals
are synthetic, loudly announced, and attributed to "insecure-auto-approve" in
the audit record. Never use that mode in production. The native-approval
story needs a macOS or Linux desktop: see Act 3 in the README.

Act 3 runs the real Linux sandbox (Opaque 0.6.0 or later). The daemon names
the strategy it used in the sandbox.created audit row; on a kernel without the
landlock LSM it drops that layer and says so instead of failing closed.

'
